Use one scratch System Administrator and create a second synthetic user with the same profile; sort their IDs. Create three Prompt records with distinct DeveloperName and MasterLabel values. For each create a PromptVersion with its own ParentId, MasterLabel and Title, DisplayType=FloatingPanel, Body=Synthetic, DisplayPosition=TopLeft, TimesToDisplay=1, DelayDays=1, UserAccess=Everyone, VersionNumber=1, DismissButtonLabel=Close, and a current StartDate. Set PublishedByUserId null, lower and higher respectively. Re-query the references and label N, L, H. At each API version query them with ORDER BY PublishedByUserId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST.
